由 $e^{x+y}+\cos(xy)=0$ 确定 $y=y(x)$，求 $y^\prime$。 $\frac{e^{x+y}+y\sin(xy)}{x\sin(xy)-e^{x+y}}$ $\frac{e^{x+y}+y\sin(xy)}{x\sin(xy)+e^{x+y}}$ $\frac{e^{x+y}-y\sin(xy)}{x\sin(xy)+e^{x+y}}$ $\frac{e^{x+y}-y\sin(xy)}{x\sin(xy)-e^{x+y}}$ 解答 方程两边同时对$x$求导可得
$e^{x+y}(1+y')-\sin(xy)(y+xy')=0$，则有$y'=\frac{e^{x+y}-y\sin(xy)}{x\sin(xy)-e^{x+y}}$
